description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Chetwynd is a branded mid-range hotel situated in Chetwynd, a small northeastern BC town at the junction of Highways 97 and 29 in the Peace River region. It is part of the Wyndham Hotels network and participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty programme. For cycle tourists riding through the remote northern interior, it represents one of the few branded accommodation options in the area.
